In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] under the command of slaver master [[Klesk]] had set up a camp in the southern part of the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]] region on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It consisted of three large tents and was guarded by well-armed Blackscale guards.

A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by the Trandoshan [[Mosolium]] of the rival [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]] ventured to this camp and killed Klesk and several of his slavers to acquire access codes to the [[Avatar Orbital Platform|Avatar Platform]].
